risk_name: Excessive Host and Sensitive API Permissions
why_it_matters: Requests permission to access all URLs and sensitive APIs, granting the extension unlimited page reading and modification scope, which poses a severe hijacking security risk.
reason: Broad host permissions allow wide context modification.
